title: 'Neave's Brother' asks for 'anything of his' from the ash flats; after fully clearing the Bell-Shard Flat, the Sand Mine, the Glazed Cairn barrow, and the Cinder Watch tower (four grave-goods collected along the way, each explicitly tagged 'nothing more is owed on it'), no item ever unlocked a new line with Neave and the quest stayed open with no further clue.
